name: SportyTilt Betting Odds Calculator
author: sportytilt

sections.description:
The SportyTilt Betting Odds Calculator makes it easy to convert between odds formats and calculate potential payouts in just a few clicks.

After receiving positive feedback from our users, we decided to share this tool with the entire WordPress community so anyone can enjoy fast, accurate odds conversions without complicated spreadsheets or manual math.

The calculator supports:
* Decimal odds
* American (moneyline) odds
* Fractional odds
* Implied probability (%)

You can also enter a wager amount to see the total payout and profit instantly.

Original version and live demo:
https://www.sportytilt.com/odds-calculator/

This plugin is lightweight, mobile-friendly, and works in any country since it displays values without currency symbols.

Developed and maintained by SportyTilt.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin or install from WordPress.org.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Add [odds_calculator] shortcode to any page or post.
sections.faq:
Can I use it on multiple sites?

Yes, the plugin is GPL licensed.

Does it support currencies?

It displays amounts without currency symbols so it’s universal.

short_description: A simple sports betting odds converter and payout calculator. Converts between decimal, American, fractional odds, and implied probability.
